subject.title: Create example OpenClaw plugin using before_install

question: Should ClawScan own and maintain an OpenClaw `before_install` plugin example in this repository, or should the integration live as an external OpenClaw package?
rationale: The requested artifact adds a durable OpenClaw-specific integration surface rather than repairing a defined CLI contract, and repository policy favors keeping the public CLI general purpose.

options.title: Approve a repository example
options.body: Define a narrow example/package boundary, supported OpenClaw version, and local smoke path, then implement the requested plugin and documentation here.

options.title: Keep the integration external
options.body: Document the hook contract and host the runnable plugin example outside the ClawScan core repository so the CLI remains general purpose.

recommendation.title: Keep the integration external
recommendation.body: Document the hook contract and host the runnable plugin example outside the ClawScan core repository so the CLI remains general purpose.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest visible history in the adjacent OpenClaw-integration area and are the collaborator who opened this product-boundary request.
